verdict.rationale: A government IP filing and search service could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant or command interface, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only form-based web filing (TEAS, Trademark Center, Patent Center), search tools, a guided assessment and an API-key-gated API. None of these is a documented way to operate the product with natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
